=== Lead photograph (30 Oct 2026) ===
The lead is a crop of a Facebook photograph posted 8 July 2017. The Facebook photo viewer names Sergio Domenech. Identification: distinctive name plus Red 49 FL on the Decipher Squadron roster (Madrid, Sp). The Facebook profile is facebook.com/sergio.domenech, a member of the Star Wars CCG Facebook group. On 8 September 2021 that profile posted the Spanish Premiere Two-Player Game rules booklet already dested on the article. The same profile has a Young Jedi CCG Spanish Test album. The uncropped original is Domenech standing in front of a decorative winged sculpture; the lead crop is Domenech alone. Wiki File is the dest JPEG of the photograph. The File page Preserved copy is the Facebook photo-viewer screenshot. Identification stays on Talk. See [[:File:Sergio Domenech portrait.jpg]] and [[:File:Sergio Domenech Facebook portrait.jpg]].
